reason: Both conversations correctly refused to name a part, checked the cool-air programme, filter and vent hose, and ended with an engineer referral given the homeowner cannot test components. Conversation 1 was more efficient and explained the clogged-hose-to-thermal-cut-out mechanism well, but it closed with an unsupported claim that a blown cut-out 'must be replaced along with the heater element to ensure safety', which would push the homeowner toward an unnecessary part. Conversation 2 took one more turn and never offered the acceptable meter-test route, but every step was safe (repeated unplug-and-cool prompts), honest about the uncertainty between element, cut-out and thermostat, and it explicitly declined to recommend any part, with no factual missteps.
